propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran minor-version upgrades on EKS clusters, draining node groups in batches with a written rollback plan for each upgrade window.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the upgrades and the former team lead confirmed them in writing.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained Terraform modules and Helm charts for the cluster infrastructure.
propositions.rationale: The resume names the modules and charts the candidate maintained.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds a current Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) certification.
propositions.rationale: The material offered for the requirement is a practice-exam score from a training simulator; a practice score and a simulator's verdict are not the certification, and the qualification rule forbids calling a candidate certified without explicit cited evidence.

expectedGap: The CKA certification is not established; the work sample is a practice-exam score report from a training simulator.
expectedBoundaryNote: Describe the practice exam as a practice exam and keep the documented upgrade, Terraform, Helm and on-call work; do not describe the candidate as CKA certified or exam-ready.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has taken the CKA exam, the date of any award and the certificate ID so it can be checked with the issuing body.
